violation_type.title: Documentation of Special Care Needs on File and Used in Planning Activities (26 TAC §746.2201(b))
violation_type.short_title: Documentation of Special Care Needs on File and Used in Planning Activities
violation_type.typical_finding: A child with special needs was denied the opportunity to work with their occupational therapist.

finding_variants.text: A child with special needs was denied the opportunity to work with their occupational therapist.

Based on information obtained through the investigation it was determined that the operation did not have documentation of special care needs on file and did not provide accommodations to a child with a differing ability.

Files of 5 children with special needs did not include documentation on basic care requirements recommended by a health-care professional or   qualified professionals affiliated with the local school district or early childhood   intervention program.
Based on the information obtained during the investigation, the permit holder is not allowing a child to receive services from an Early Childhood Intervention program at their facility.
